reviews.text: After much research and visiting several animal hospitals, I finally found this one. It was difficult to get an appointment with the head veterinarian, and I was worried whether it would be alright if it wasn't the head veterinarian. However, even with other veterinarians, the wait was at least a week, and for surgery, it was a month, so I realized it was a popular hospital. I visited several hospitals, and some just pushed expensive treatments, but this one explained the pros and cons in detail, and in the end, I was glad I chose this one. My dog ​​is shy and I couldn't brush his teeth properly, and because I was an uninformed owner, I gave him hard treats as a temporary solution, which caused him to chip his teeth. It was too late to regret it, and he was still young, so I wondered what to do, and I considered saving the teeth, but they also considered the risks after reconstruction, especially because he was young. I was worried about anesthesia and such, but when I went to pick him up, he was so energetic that I wondered if he had really had surgery. His teeth were very clean, and his bad breath was gone. In the end, some teeth were extracted, but we will do our best to save the remaining teeth.

We've been using this clinic since our previous dog was born. They treated our previous dog here at the end of his life, and although he passed away, they did everything they could.

The clinic is clean, and the facilities seem sufficient. I recall our previous dog had poor test results, and they even placed him in what seemed like an intensive care unit.

The doctors, and of course the staff, are all very polite and kind.

We used their pet hotel service for a wedding/funeral, and they provided a report. I believe our dog had a comfortable stay, perhaps playing in the upstairs area.

Currently, due to moving, we need to find a new veterinarian in our new home, but I'm having trouble finding a clinic of this caliber. Even before moving, it wasn't exactly close, but we usually drove there for checkups, and they provided parking tickets for their affiliated parking lots, which was very helpful. It's also not far from Ogikubo Station on foot.

Since the head veterinarian is skilled in dentistry, I personally think it was fortunate that he was able to examine my dog's teeth at the same time as the neutering procedure and perform any necessary extractions.
We've been going to this hospital since our previous dog was born. It's a very good hospital.

I've been using this clinic for my dog's cavity treatment. I trust them because they provide very thorough examinations and explanations.

This is my only choice for my dog's dentist.

The clinic is clean and spacious, which is a great help.

Thank you for your continued support.

My 9-year-old Toy Poodle received invaluable care from Dr. Machida and his staff.

The reason we visited was because my dog ​​fractured his lower jaw during a non-anesthetic dental cleaning at a local animal hospital.

I deeply regret choosing the non-anesthetic dental cleaning and putting my dog ​​through such a terrible experience.

I searched extensively for a good veterinarian who could examine both the fracture and periodontal disease, visiting local animal hospitals and searching online. Fortunately, we were able to see Dr. Machida, who examined my dog ​​kindly and thoroughly, and explained the treatment plan clearly and concisely, allowing me to entrust my dog ​​to his care with complete peace of mind.

Dr. Machida was incredibly empathetic to my feelings as a pet owner, and always offered kind words.

I was constantly blaming myself, and his words were such a great comfort…
This experience has reinforced my belief that pet owners must have solid knowledge when choosing hospitals and treatment methods.

It took three months for my child to fully recover, but he loved seeing the doctor and always happily walked around the clinic without any fuss.

The doctor also gave us guidance on brushing our child's teeth, and made me realize that my own brushing technique wasn't good enough.

It was a sad experience, but I'm so glad we found such a wonderful doctor.

We look forward to your continued support.

Dear swak xoxo,
Thank you very much for your kind words and high praise of our clinic.
We will continue to strive to improve the quality of our examinations and treatments so that you can entrust your beloved family members to us with complete peace of mind.
We look forward to your next visit.
Ogikubo Twin Animal Hospital
Director: Kengo Machida

As a dental specialist, I think they are excellent when it comes to treating teeth.
However, regarding the anesthesia involved...
After being hospitalized for several days, I was advised to transfer to another hospital at the very last moment, or rather, I felt like I was being kicked out. They took my cyanotic dog out of the oxygen chamber and said, "We can still make it," which was incredibly irresponsible. My dog ​​died that day.

Dear M K,
Thank you for your kind feedback.
Please feel free to contact us anytime if you have any concerns. Our entire staff will continue to strive to support the lives of you and your beloved pets. Thank you for your continued support.
Ogikubo Twin Animal Hospital
Director: Kengo Machida

I have my pet here for regular checkups and dental treatment. They always give me thorough explanations, which makes me feel at ease during visits. I used to go to different veterinary clinics, so I wish I had started going to this one sooner.

Dr. Machida performed scaling on my senior dog (female toy poodle). I am grateful that he examined the affected area that other clinics couldn't find, and performed a thorough examination and surgery. I would like to have my younger dog 🐶 treated as well. I have come to realize how important teeth are for dogs. I look forward to continuing to use your services in the future.
